title: Rides on Railways
author: Samuel Sidney

authorInfo.bio: Samuel Sidney (1813–1883) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Rides on Railways" by Samuel Sidney is a travel narrative written during the mid-19th century. The work offers a detailed exploration of various railway routes across England, particularly focusing on the landscapes, towns, and economies encountered along the way.
